title: Synchronize delegation state and expose ordinary unreceipted dispatches held by host shutdown
outcome: Resolve the local ordinary-dispatch shutdown early return that skips delegation-attempt synchronization; define a visible or retained disposition for an accepted nonreceipted prompt without broadening remote replay permission.
acceptance: An ordinary nonreceipted dispatch reaching host shutdown has a documented and tested disposition, and delegation child-attempt state is synchronized consistently with the actual turn.
A focused control covers the host-shutdown early return; unrelated local dispatch and remote unknown-effect retention remain unchanged.
